# Mobile Knowledge

## Stack

- Expo SDK 57, Expo Router, React Native, SecureStore, SQLite, NetInfo, FileSystem, Sharing, Vitest, and Playwright web preview.
- Available scripts: `npm run android`, `npm run eas:build:preflight`, `npm run export:web`, `npm run ios`, `npm run lint`, `npm run postinstall`, `npm run start`, `npm run store:assets`, `npm run store:check`, `npm run store:check:ci`, `npm run store:screenshots`, `npm run store:submission`, `npm run store:submission:check`, `npm run test`, `npm run test:e2e:web`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run web`.

## Key Paths

- `app/` contains Expo Router screens and tab layout.
- `src/app-state.tsx` owns auth, forced logout, idle sync/logout, SQLite cleanup, and sync orchestration.
- `src/database.ts` stores item payloads, mutations, and sync metadata in SQLite.
- `src/item-filters.ts` and `src/item-organization.ts` centralize local filter and organize semantics.
- `builds/` holds native build evidence manifests; signed `.ipa`, `.aab`, and `.apk` artifacts stay ignored.

## Rules

- Treat `401` sync failures as session expiry and clear local account data.
- Use native `Alert.alert` confirmations for destructive mobile actions.
- Release work must update `docs/GOAL-1/MOBILE_*` docs and verify EAS/App Store/Play gaps.
